verdict.rationale: dltHub's Web UI and CLI let engineers monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures, and dlt states 'every run is logged and auditable' (dlt-docs-15, dlt-docs-26), which covers run status/log visibility. However, there is no evidence of per-sync row-count reporting or of built-in alerting integrations to Slack, email, or webhooks. missing for 10: row-count reporting per sync, Slack/email/webhook alerting integration, evidence of failure notification configuration.
